benchmarks.name: DC Gravity Suppression (Highpass >0.5 Hz)
benchmarks.input: 9.81 m/s² DC + 0.25 m/s² 5Hz sine, fs=50Hz, duration=5s

benchmarks.name: Bandpass 1.0 Hz Low-Frequency Rejection
benchmarks.input: 0.50 m/s² 1.0 Hz sine relative to 5.0 Hz passband

benchmarks.name: Bandpass 15.0 Hz High-Frequency Rejection
benchmarks.input: 0.50 m/s² 15.0 Hz sine relative to 5.0 Hz passband

benchmarks.name: 3D Rotation Invariance (Summed 3D PSD, No Rectification Doubling)
benchmarks.input: 0.25 m/s² 5.0 Hz at 0°, 45°, 90°, and 3D diagonal orientations
benchmarks.threshold: Identical ~5.0 Hz dominant freq (delta<=0.15Hz), RMS within 0.03 m/s²
benchmarks.measured: Parallel to gravity (pure Z): freq=4.99Hz, rms=0.175; Perpendicular to gravity (pure X): freq=4.99Hz, rms=0.175; 45-deg oblique in X-Z: freq=4.99Hz, rms=0.175; Arbitrary 3D diagonal: freq=4.99Hz, rms=0.175

benchmarks.name: Dominant Frequency Estimation Accuracy (Parabolic Refinement)
benchmarks.measured: Max error 0.010 Hz across all tones

benchmarks.name: RMS Linearity Deviation (vs A / sqrt(2))
benchmarks.input: Peak amplitudes 0.10 to 0.80 m/s² at 5.0 Hz

benchmarks.name: Multi-Rate Consistency (40 Hz, 50 Hz, 60 Hz)
benchmarks.input: 5.0 Hz pure tone sampled at 40 Hz, 50 Hz, and 60 Hz
benchmarks.threshold: Dominant freq error <= 0.15 Hz without rate distortion
